- **G? [S] A far outing starts with the drive: Plan an outing offers Start alone** (2026-11-27) · Honour · aligned
  From: /investigate, the owner's ask (2026-11-27). Brief: docs/research/outing-arrival-start.md.
  Calls: one session records from your tap, the drive then the walk, the way on your tap on arrival ("Record from the start, my tap (Recommended)"); Start alone on the outing page, Explore's card keeping its ask ("Start alone, outing page (Recommended)"); with no position Start begins and records from the first fix ("Start, waits for a fix (Recommended)"); a stop on the way as today, drive-in-the-outing part 2 next as G? ("As today, then DO18-DO23 (Recommended)"). Decision 0274, amending 0121 (its far ask on this page) and 0218 (DO6 there).
  Mock-up: not needed (mockup.md): a button and its line removed from an existing footer.
  Done when: on the web build at 390 x 844, Plan an outing toward a town past 2 km shows Start alone; tapped, a drive to the town is recorded as a ride in the session, the bar says "<Town> is here." with "Show the way" and routes nothing until tapped, and after Stop the replay draws the dashed drive and the walk after it.
  Area: outing.
  Touches: VISION.md Never "All-day tracking" (0036: nothing records before the tap) and "Nagging" (nothing on arrival), Always "A route is a suggestion"; decisions 0121 (its tap kept, its far ask amended here by 0274), 0209, 0213, 0218 (DO1, DO2, DO7; DO6 amended here); specs OJ28.
  The slice: 1. On Plan an outing, a journey whose first town is past 2 km, or a page with no position yet, shows Start alone in the footer with "Start records from here, toward <Town>."; no "When I get there", no "keeps <Town> only" and no "waits in Navigate" line. 2. That Start begins the session at once with the whole journey as its plan and no way on foot; the ride is recorded inside it and every town is carried by the session's bar; reaching the first town the bar says "<Town> is here." with "Show the way", and nothing routes, starts, sounds or notifies until that tap (0121, DO1, DO2). 3. With no position yet, Start begins the session, which records from its first fix with the plan carried; the session's screen says nothing new about the missing fix. 4. Explore's area card, tiles and pressed spot still ask as today (DW3, DO6); the `drive` and `startfar` journeys pass unchanged, and the `journey` journey shows the far footer at 390 and 320 px.
  Precedent: Google Maps Timeline keeps "visits and routes" together once opted in (verified, support.google.com); Polarsteps turns its tracker on when a trip is made and keeps the route between places (unverified). Neither waits for the arrival to begin; this departs from Timeline in that nothing records before the tap. docs/research/adjacent-apps.md, "Keep a drive as part of the day".
  Payoff: every far outing; the drive and its stops are kept with the outing, and the page has no button that silently records nothing. Cost: S, five source files: `lib/outing/choice.ts`, `lib/outing/useJourney.ts`, `lib/outing/journeyWords.ts`, `components/outing/OutingPage.tsx`, `app/(tabs)/explore.tsx`; no native code. Reopens: outing. After it: G? (the drive in the replay by its length).
  Instead: the two buttons reworded to say what each keeps.

- **G? [M] The drive in the replay: a ride's share by its length, along the road, its distance in words** (2026-11-27) · Return · aligned if reshaped
  From: /investigate, the owner's ask (2026-11-27). Brief: docs/research/outing-arrival-start.md. After: G18.
  Calls: a stop on the way stays the walker standing on the dashed ride, no mark of its own; drive-in-the-outing part 2 built next ("As today, then DO18-DO23 (Recommended)"). Decision 0274.
  Done when: on the web build at 390 x 844, the replay of an outing with a 20 km drive gives the drive longer than one with a 2 km drive, draws it dashed along the road it took, and its card says the drive's distance in words ("+ 20 km by ride"), the five beats in their order.
  Area: replay, rides.
  Touches: VISION.md Never "Fitness numbers" and "Tallies" (no speed or time of a drive, DO3), Always "Restraint" and the five beats in a fixed order (0001), the soft cap (0085); decisions 0040 and rides R10 (amended by DO19), 0218; specs DO18-DO23 (gated in `specs/drive-in-the-outing/spec.md`, aligned if reshaped).
  The slice: 1. The drive is part of the path beat; the five beats keep their order and none is added (DO18). 2. A ride's share of the path beat follows its length in place of R10's fixed four seconds, a zip with the camera pulled back, under the soft cap (DO19). 3. The ride is drawn dashed along the road it took, never straight lines between its ends (DO20). 4. A capture made on a ride stops the replay as one on foot does (DO21). 5. The card and the replay say the drive's distance in words ("+ 84 km by ride") and nothing else of it (DO22). 6. A replay that is mostly drive still ends on the rest and the title, the lows in (DO23). 7. The `replay` journey seeds a long and a short drive and pictures the drive at 390 and 320 px.
  Precedent: Polarsteps' straight lines between stops are what users complain of (unverified), the model DO20 avoids; Google Maps Timeline keeps the routes between visits (verified, support.google.com). docs/research/adjacent-apps.md, "Keep a drive as part of the day".
  Payoff: every outing with a drive; the trip there comes back in the replay at its true size. Cost: M, about four source files: `lib/ceremony/rhythm.ts`, `lib/ceremony/camera.ts`, the card's words (`lib/replay.ts`), the summary's ride lengths (`lib/summary.ts`); no native code beyond the native map's replay draw (unverified). Reopens: replay. Reviewed by the steward and the ux-reviewer.
  Instead: DO20 and DO22 alone (the road drawn, the distance said), R10's four seconds kept.
  Open: the mock-up of a long drive's share of the path beat, the camera pulled back (mockup.md: a transition), approved before code.
